resources.title: How to BEAT the Luna VI/6.5 Spiral Abyss — F2P Guide with Tips and Tricks
resources.creator: Mr. Mondstadt
resources.noteEs: Walkthrough completo de Spiral Abyss 6.5 (Luna VI) desde perspectiva F2P. Mr. Mondstadt cubre cada cámara del piso 12 con team comps accesibles, tips por encounter, y troubleshooting de los DPS checks que typically frenan a players sin 5-stars meta. Anchor del cluster.
resources.noteEn: Complete Spiral Abyss 6.5 (Luna VI) walkthrough from F2P perspective. Mr. Mondstadt covers each floor 12 chamber with accessible team comps, per-encounter tips, and troubleshooting for the DPS checks that typically gate players without meta 5-stars. Cluster anchor.

resources.title: Can you full star SPIRAL ABYSS using OLD CHARACTERS?
resources.creator: Tenha
resources.noteEs: Tenha (codex Genshin) ataca el Abyss 6.5 usando solo characters viejos. Útil más allá del clickbait — demuestra que muchos archetypes pre-Sumeru siguen siendo viables si están bien construidos. Para players F2P con cuentas viejas que dudan de invertir wishes en characters nuevos, este video da framework de decisión.
resources.noteEn: Tenha (codex Genshin creator) tackles 6.5 Abyss using only old characters. Useful beyond clickbait — shows that many pre-Sumeru archetypes are still viable when properly built. For F2P players with old accounts who hesitate to invest wishes in new characters, this gives decision framework.

resources.title: The BEST Teams to DESTROY Spiral Abyss 6.5 — F2P Weapons & Tips
resources.creator: Conquer30
resources.noteEs: Conquer30 lista los mejores teams para Spiral Abyss 6.5, todos jugables con armas F2P y characters de la mayoría de cuentas establecidas. Foco en clear consistente más que clears flashy de showcase — útil para players que necesitan los stars del season pass.
resources.noteEn: Conquer30 lists the best teams for Spiral Abyss 6.5, all playable with F2P weapons and characters from most established accounts. Focus on consistent clears rather than flashy showcase clears — useful for players who need the season-pass stars.
